So today I was just walking around downtown for no particular reason, just killing time. And I noticed this little store I'd never seen before, tucked away down a side street. I went inside out of curiosity and they had all sorts of random stuff - old typewriters, vinyl records, antique kitchen gadgets. But the thing that really caught my eye was this tiny little pouch, maybe the size of a wallet. I was browsing the "household" section, never really thinking I'd buy anything. But then I picked up this pouch and it was so dang handy. It's like a little duffel bag that zips up, just big enough to carry a water bottle, my phone, my wallet. I never realized I needed something like this until I held it in my hand. It's perfect for carrying around
